notes.body: Research programme extended (2026-07-06) with four new sub-problems + investigations, sequenced around two prerequisites. (1) TRUSTWORTHY EVAL [trustworthy-leakage-free-evaluation-of-translation-quality → clean_eval_leakage_fix_v1]: the gold-in-exemplar leak (translation-prompt-context note-2) means the eval harness must be fixed (self-concept exclusion) before any guide/context comparison is trusted; the ~100 extension-external SME terms are the only currently-clean human references. (2) SME FEEDBACK [exploiting-sme-terminologist-feedback → sme_judge_agreement_v1, sme_error_taxonomy_v1]: calibrate the LLM judge against SME verdicts and mine an error taxonomy; child problem [selecting-the-next-sme-review-batch → sme_batch_selection_v1] designs batch 2 (40/40/20: stratified frontier / active disagreement / reliability repeats). (3) CONSISTENCY [term-level-consistency-across-the-terminology → term_consistency_metric_v1]: reference-free same-component-same-rendering metric; also a confidence feature + glossary source. (4) TRIAGE [confidence-based-review-triage-policy → triage_policy_v1, under output-translations-confidence]: combine the validated confidence signals into a routing policy scored in SME-hours saved. Plus hierarchy_retrieval_exemplars_v1 under translation-prompt-context (parents/siblings as exemplars — gated on the clean harness). Back-translation ideas were NOT duplicated: already covered by the snomed_backtrans_* investigations.
notes.author: agent

notes.body:
PROCESS FORMALISATION + PROJECT GUIDE (2026-08-25, commit 5878157).

The Korean project's working method is now written up as a formal, language-agnostic process: docs/language_project_guide_2026-08-25.md (also published as a shareable page for management). Structure: Phase 0 provisioning (wizard) → Phase 1 foundations (pool curation, index, seed guide) → Phase 2 baseline cascade + detector family → Phase 3 the SME round loop (package-with-blinded-sample → review → ingest → measure tier separation + absorption → fold in deterministic-first → repair-or-retranslate under lock/gates → audit → next pack) → Phase 4 GEPA (post-saturation, leak-free, rule-frozen, promotion-gated) → Phase 5 delivery gates. Nine standing laws distilled from three rounds of mistakes and fixes.

FORMALISATION PROPOSAL: ship the process as a PROJECT TEMPLATE (seed_project_template + flow-cloning): pre-created problems per phase, gated plan tasks, the ten language-parameterised flows, standing conclusions carrying the laws. A new language then starts with the method installed rather than rediscovered.

RESOURCE MODEL (all anchors from tracked runs): SME 2-4 h/round, 3-5 rounds, 10-20 h per ~5k-concept domain (+50% greenfield); API = concepts × escalation_rate × 7.5k input tokens per pass (measured 16.87M tokens / 2,253 calls on run d7897383b0e7 → ~$17-51/pass at $1-3/M), 2-3 passes/project, repair passes free; one GPU workstation, full chain <1 h wall-clock; escalation rate doubles as a language-support health metric; calendar dominated by SME turnaround (~2-3 months at 2-week rounds).
notes.author: agent

notes.body:
PROCESS TEMPLATE BUILT + GREENFIELD DEMO INSTANTIATED (2026-08-25).

`translation_process` template (snomed_translation/templates/translation_process, commit-tracked): the guide's method as installable machinery — 8 phase problems (root, foundations, baseline+QA, SME-round-loop parent, round-1, editorial-rulings ledger, GEPA, delivery), a 14-task plan with 5 gates (inputs-sourced, baseline-measured, tier-separation-measured, prompt-promotion, SME sign-off w/ requires_signoff), 9 language-parameterised flows (cascade, qa-gate, rule-repair, package-review, ingest-review, tier-separation, merge-gold, absorption-test, curate-pool), forward-declared domain/adjudicated sources, seed hard-rule + pool-rule YAMLs, and the nine laws as pre-installed conclusions. instantiate_template extended: {{configs_dir}}/{{rf2_relationship_file}} placeholders, conclusions merge (append/dedup, never clobber), verbatim files/ payload with __code__ path substitution. seed_project_template MCP tool exposes template + rf2 params.

DEMO: project `kog` "Korean (greenfield demo)" — scaffolded cold-start (no target RF2 extension, EMPTY pool, EMPTY gold; domain = the same 5,012 imaging concepts EN-side), template seeded, registered (app port 8102, MCP port 8767, server snomed-research-kog, systemd units live). Verified over HTTP: all 8 problems, all 9 flows, the populated plan, and the 9 laws render in the instance. The demo shows exactly what a new language starts with: the method installed, plan task-1 = source the gating inputs, and the greenfield reality visible (first cascade run needs a pool; the first SME round doubles as the language's first gold).
